rationale: Post-hoc descriptive accounting of already consumed complete eight-arm development evidence, not another evaluation or tuning step. Integer SQL-call/gap walltime partition and separate accumulated response/waiting; per-template actual call summaries and within-action repeat differences. Source inventory retains original unscaled 20-minute clock bins and minute counts to describe candidate demand patterns only; no untouched-window or host-idle claim, no missing/empty bins imputed and no launch/threshold/fit selected. No new SQL or maintenance.
